item.artificesassortie.grip_hold_stabili: Hold [%s] to enter stabilization mode and gain the following effects

item.artificesassortie.item_transfer_mod: Teleports item drops from mobs killed by your bullets to your feet
Also teleports nearby items and experience orbs at the impact location to your feet
Each additional modifier extends the transfer range by 1 block
item.artificesassortie.excavation_modifi: Mines blocks instead of simply destroying them
Additional modifiers raise the mining tool tier
Disables terrain damage against blocks that cannot be mined
Reduces the effect of block explosion resistance on terrain damage
Combine with %s to teleport mined drops to your feet
Hold Shift to switch to detailed mining information
1 modifier: Iron tools; 2: Diamond; 3 or more: Netherite
Additional modifiers only raise the tool tier; mining speed depends on bullet damage
Mines blocks requiring no tool, or a suitable pickaxe, axe, shovel, or hoe
This bullet deals no terrain damage if its tool type or tier is insufficient
item.artificesassortie.healing_oil_modif: Direct bullet hits and blasts heal their targets instead of dealing damage
Undead take damage that bypasses armor and shields instead of being healed
Direct hits and blasts can also hit you, allies, and pets
Installing %s in the same gun restores normal targeting and turns healing into damage
Precision Fire's headshot and non-headshot multipliers do not apply
Additional effects such as burning, chain lightning, and soulfire are not converted to healing
item.artificesassortie.harming_oil_modif: Direct bullet hits and blasts bypass armor and shields
Undead are healed instead of taking damage
Witches' magic resistance greatly reduces the damage
Installing %s in the same gun also makes undead take damage instead of being healed
Precision Fire's headshot and non-headshot multipliers do not apply

The gun sums doses of exactly matching potions used consecutively in firing order
Consumes one potion dose per shot and imbues every projectile fired in that shot
